name: 2013 World Championships Deck: Ultimate Team Plasma

releases.name: 2013 World Championships Deck: Ultimate Team Plasma

description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Junior Division at the 2013 World Championships, built to get the most out of Kyurem's Blizzard Burn: Thundurus-EX powers it up quickly, Deoxys-EX adds damage, and with Hypnotoxic Laser and Virbank City Gym even Pokémon-EX can be Knocked Out in one turn. The 2013 World Championships were held at the Vancouver Convention Centre in Vancouver, Canada, from 9 to 11 August 2013, the first outside the United States.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2013 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
